plugins.name: folio
plugins.description: Send anything worth reading to your reMarkable or Kindle. Saves articles and written text to your Folio inbox, bundles them into typeset issues, and delivers PDFs and EPUBs to your e-ink device, Dropbox or Google Drive.

skills.name: read-the-inbox
skills.description: Look through the articles already saved in the user's Folio inbox — find one, summarise it, tidy the queue, or bundle a few into an issue and send them to a device.

skills.name: research-and-send
skills.description: Research a topic, summarise a conversation, or triage what the user should read, then deliver the write-up to their reMarkable, Kindle, Dropbox or Google Drive as a typeset PDF.

skills.name: save-to-folio
skills.description: Save a link, article, or written text to the user's Folio inbox so they can read it later on their e-ink device.

skills.name: send-to-device
skills.description: Turn content into a PDF or EPUB laid out for the user's e-ink device and deliver it to their reMarkable, Kindle, Dropbox or Google Drive.

skills.name: set-up-routines
skills.description: Set up, change, pause or explain a recurring Folio delivery — a morning brief, a weekly digest, an RSS subscription that feeds it — so issues arrive on the user's device on a schedule.

skills.name: write-on-templates
skills.description: Create a planner, worksheet, or note template laid out for handwriting and deliver it to the e-ink device the user writes on. Also use when the user asks for template ideas or names a known layout (bullet journal, Cornell notes, GTD weekly, habit tracker).
